text: ATM Audience Scorecard · September 2026 update · Sep 1–28 vs Aug 1–28 · pulled Sep 29, 2026
Fewer impressions, more conversation, and partners carried the reach.

LinkedIn impressions fell from the July–August peak, but comments rose 80% and the engagement rate held. Where a partner reposted with their own copy, the piece reached 7–8× its organic engagement. On Instagram, the top three posts were all accepted collabs. The newsletter list grew on imports, and human clicks per reader slipped.

September baseline: ATM wins the open. It loses the follow-through.

The audience is senior and opens above every trade-media benchmark. Then almost nothing happens next: clicks, sign-ups, search and organic growth all sit below par, because 98% of the active list was imported and under 2% was earned by the content. The Optin cohort makes the open rate look better and the click rate worse; YouTube's 200K views were 90% paid; Google sends ~150 clicks a month, all of them brand searches. Every one of those is fixable without a clickbait headline, and most of the fixes are plumbing.
